revision_before_editorial_review.rationale: This unit introduces 5th-grade students to the foundational concepts of data's role in prediction, particularly focusing on how the quality and representativeness of data impact outcomes. By understanding how information is processed and evaluated, students can critically assess simple predictive models. The progression moves from basic data understanding to identifying patterns and finally to evaluating the consequences of flawed data, aligning with the 'data and AI' strand's goal of fostering data literacy.
